projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Here are some of the projects I've worked on.

projects.title: É de Chão
projects.description: Full-stack café site with public menu, reservations, and an admin panel.
projects.longDescription: É de Chão is a Next.js café site for São Paulo: public menu and story pages, timezone-aware open/closed status, a reservation flow with Zod validation, and an Auth.js-protected admin for menu, hours, discounts, blog, and bookings. Data lives on Neon (Postgres) via Drizzle. Live demo and source are linked below.
projects.imageAlt: É de Chão home page hero

gallery.alt: Home page with hero and open/closed status

projects.title: VetPay
projects.description: Tele-vet platform with client pets/appointments and an admin CRM.
projects.longDescription: VetPay is a Next.js tele-veterinary app: public marketing pages, a client area for pets and bookings, and an admin CRM. Auth uses NextAuth (Credentials + Google) with role-based middleware. Data lives on Neon via Drizzle, with Zod validation on server actions.

gallery.alt: Client dashboard and add pet form

projects.title: Project three
projects.description: A small project about fetching data and showing it clearly.
projects.longDescription: Project three is about taking data from an API and turning it into a readable UI. I focused on loading states, empty results, and keeping the layout consistent. The GitHub repo has the source if you want to follow the data path.

about.title: About
about.body: I’m a frontend developer focused on building clear, accessible interfaces. I work with React and Next.js, and I’m using this site to show what I can do.
